text:
Mira Patel: quick heads-up — Pulseboard spike looks weird after the launch post. Traffic is up ~30% but webinar registrations are down ~40% vs last week. Anyone seeing this in other reports? https://redwood.app/dashboards/kpi-pulseboard :eyes:
analytics-bot: ALERT: campaign 'launch-2026-03' leads dropped 42% (7d avg vs prev 7d). More details: https://redwood.app/alerts/1132
Sam Ortiz: is the Pulseboard window still using rolling 7d? that can mask the immediate launch spike -> drop pattern. Also could be UTM mismatch. can you paste the campaign link?
Mira Patel: dashboard is on 7d by default — looking at daily view now. campaign link is https://redwood.app/landing?utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=launch-2026&utm_medium=email
Jason Lee: quick query I ran against leads (production.leads):
```
SELECT count(*) FROM production.leads
WHERE received_at >= '2026-03-15'
AND campaign = 'launch-2026'
```
Result: 148 leads (since 2026-03-15). Last week same window was 255.
Lara Nguyen: did we change the registration iframe or GTM tag on the landing page during the resend? I remember a DOM id rename for the A/B test.
Sam Ortiz: good call. @Lara — variant B changed the form id to `register-v2` on 3/17. if tracking relies on `form-submit` listener it could fail. can someone check the page source or GA events?
Mira Patel: @Sam @Jason can you check GA4 vs our ingestion? GA4 shows 190 signups for the same period. discrepancy ~42 leads.
Jason Lee: looks like our ETL filters out events without `lead_email` — some iframe submissions came through without that param. simple fix on the enrich job. i'll run a backfill for 3/15-3/19. ETA 2h.
Sam Ortiz: also check UTM parsing — we had a missing `utm_medium=email` on the March resend for ~4k clicks. that could change attribution buckets.
Lara Nguyen: ok i'm going to confirm the form change and send the frontend diff. if anyone needs the variant comparison page: https://redwood.app/variants/launch-2026
Mira Patel: plan: Jason backfills and fixes ETL filter; Sam validates GA events and UTM parsing; Lara confirms form id and sends diff to eng. i'll update the weekly KPI doc and re-run the pulseboard snapshot after backfill.
Sam Ortiz: sounds good. ping me when backfill completes and i'll reconcile GA vs internal numbers. :thumbsup:
analytics-bot: BACKFILL job 442 queued by Jason Lee (ETA ~2h). Status: queued.
Jason Lee: starting the backfill now. will post completion timestamp.
Mira Patel: thanks — will hold the launch post performance note for Monday's KPI review until we reconcile. :calendar:
